Ordinary workpool, recursive readdir, copy-parent and Windows UV task paths share the resource helper. Copy/readdir parent lifetime now extends through result delivery, including early conversion errors. Shell-only workers are not routed through JS request hooks, and script shutdown avoids new JS lifecycle calls.

Node/Home conformance covers success/failure, ordinary writes/reads/stats/copy, recursive readdir and cp, request identity and async-local continuation preservation. Worker filesystem shutdown and all 25 native groups pass. Generated C++ binding bytes match source.
limitations: Promise engine creation/resolution hooks and continuation ID propagation remain incomplete; the linked JSC interface lacks a general promise creation/fulfillment callback. Callback adapters, sockets/DNS/worker producers and wider operation/abort/collection/shutdown behavior remain open in #877. This does not establish complete fs or async-hooks parity.

Node optimized promise APIs may use FSREQCALLBACK/ReadFileJob resources; Home instruments its actual native promise tasks as FSREQPROMISE. Backend request grouping/type parity and callback API lifecycle require further work. Windows UV paths are implemented but not behaviorally verified.
